title: 第8课 · 你去哪儿我就去哪儿
subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 8 — 你去哪儿我就去哪儿 · I'll go wherever you go

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在休息室 — In the lounge

items.en: again
to be satisfied
elevator
(measure word for floors)
to be afraid, to be scared

items.zh: 同事：听说你最近打算买房子？
items.py: Tóngshì: Tīngshuō nǐ zuìjìn dǎsuàn mǎi fángzi?
items.en: Colleague: I hear you're planning to buy a house?

items.zh: 小丽：是，昨天去看了看，今天又去看了看，明天还要再去看看。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Shì, zuótiān qù kànle kàn, jīntiān yòu qù kànle kàn, míngtiān hái yào zài qù kànkan.
items.en: Xiaoli: Yes. I went to look yesterday, went again today, and I'm going to look again tomorrow.
Colleague: You weren't happy with any of them?

items.zh: 小丽：一个没有电梯，不方便。一个有电梯，但是在二十层。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Yī ge méiyǒu diàntī, bù fāngbiàn. Yī ge yǒu diàntī, dànshì zài èrshí céng.
items.en: Xiaoli: One has no elevator, which is inconvenient. One has an elevator, but it's on the 20th floor.
Colleague: What's wrong with the 20th floor?

items.zh: 小丽：太高了，往下看多害怕啊！
items.py: Xiǎolì: Tài gāo le, wǎng xià kàn duō hàipà a!
items.en: Xiaoli: It's too high. Looking down would be so scary!

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在学校 — At school

items.en: panda
to meet

items.zh: 小明：听说你下个星期就要回国了？
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Tīngshuō nǐ xià ge xīngqī jiù yào huí guó le?
items.en: Xiaoming: I hear you're going back to your country next week?

items.zh: 马可：是啊，真不想离开北京。
items.py: Mǎkě: Shì a, zhēn bù xiǎng líkāi Běijīng.
items.en: Mark: Yes. I really don't want to leave Beijing.

items.zh: 小明：我下星期不在北京，不能去机场送你了。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Wǒ xià xīngqī bù zài Běijīng, bù néng qù jīchǎng sòng nǐ le.
items.en: Xiaoming: I won't be in Beijing next week, so I can't see you off at the airport.

items.py: Mǎkě: Méi guānxi, nǐ máng ba.
items.en: Mark: That's OK, you go about your business.

items.zh: 小明：这个小熊猫送给你，欢迎你以后再到中国来。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Zhège xiǎo xióngmāo sòng gěi nǐ, huānyíng nǐ yǐhòu zài dào Zhōngguó lái.
items.en: Xiaoming: This little panda is for you. You're welcome to come back to China in the future.

items.zh: 马可：谢谢。希望以后能再见面。
items.py: Mǎkě: Xièxie. Xīwàng yǐhòu néng zài jiàn miàn.
items.en: Mark: Thank you. I hope we can meet again someday.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在咖啡厅 — In a coffee house

items.en: quiet
cola, Coke
a moment
immediately, at once
bathroom, restroom
Xiaoli: Xiaogang, where shall we sit?

items.zh: 小刚：你坐哪儿我就坐哪儿。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Nǐ zuò nǎr wǒ jiù zuò nǎr.
items.en: Xiaogang: I'll sit wherever you sit.

items.zh: 小丽：坐这儿吧，这儿安静。你想喝什么饮料？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Zuò zhèr ba, zhèr ānjìng. Nǐ xiǎng hē shénme yǐnliào?
items.en: Xiaoli: Let's sit here; it's quiet. What would you like to drink?

items.zh: 小刚：你喝什么我就喝什么。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Nǐ hē shénme wǒ jiù hē shénme.
items.en: Xiaogang: I'll have whatever you have.

items.zh: 小丽：喝可乐吧。你等我一会儿，我马上回来。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Hē kělè ba. Nǐ děng wǒ yīhuìr, wǒ mǎshàng huílai.
items.en: Xiaoli: Let's have cola. Wait for me a moment, I'll be right back.

items.zh: 小刚：小丽，你去哪儿？你去哪儿我就去哪儿。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Xiǎolì, nǐ qù nǎr? Nǐ qù nǎr wǒ jiù qù nǎr.
items.en: Xiaogang: Xiaoli, where are you going? I'll go wherever you go.
Xiaoli: I'm going to the restroom.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在周明家 — At Zhou Ming's home

items.en: old
almost
to change
healthy
important

items.zh: 老同学：快五年了，你几乎没变化。
items.py: Lǎo tóngxué: Kuài wǔ nián le, nǐ jīhū méi biànhuà.
items.en: Old classmate: It's been almost five years, and you've hardly changed.

items.zh: 周太太：谁说的？我胖了，以前的衣服都不能穿了。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Shéi shuō de? Wǒ pàng le, yǐqián de yīfu dōu bù néng chuān le.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Who says? I've put on weight; I can't wear any of my old clothes.

items.zh: 老同学：健康最重要，胖瘦没关系。
items.py: Lǎo tóngxué: Jiànkāng zuì zhòngyào, pàng shòu méi guānxi.
items.en: Old classmate: Health is what matters most; fat or thin doesn't matter.

items.zh: 周太太：是呀，想吃什么就吃什么。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Shì ya, xiǎng chī shénme jiù chī shénme.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Right, I eat whatever I feel like.

items.zh: 老同学：你做饭还是周明做饭？
items.py: Lǎo tóngxué: Nǐ zuò fàn háishi Zhōu Míng zuò fàn?
items.en: Old classmate: Do you do the cooking, or does Zhou Ming?

items.zh: 周太太：我做，我想吃什么就做什么，想吃多少就做多少。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Wǒ zuò, wǒ xiǎng chī shénme jiù zuò shénme, xiǎng chī duōshao jiù zuò duōshao.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: I do. I cook whatever I want to eat, and as much as I want to eat.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (又 vs 再)

items.zh: 上个星期我买了一条裤子，昨天又买了一条。
items.py: Shàng ge xīngqī wǒ mǎile yī tiáo kùzi, zuótiān yòu mǎile yī tiáo.
items.en: I bought a pair of trousers last week, and yesterday I bought another pair.

items.zh: 你上午已经喝了一杯咖啡，下午怎么又喝了一杯？
items.py: Nǐ shàngwǔ yǐjīng hēle yī bēi kāfēi, xiàwǔ zěnme yòu hēle yī bēi?
items.en: You already had a cup of coffee this morning. Why did you have another one this afternoon?

items.zh: 小刚，你前天迟到，昨天迟到，今天怎么又迟到了？
items.py: Xiǎogāng, nǐ qiántiān chídào, zuótiān chídào, jīntiān zěnme yòu chídào le?
items.en: Xiaogang, you were late the day before yesterday and yesterday. Why are you late again today?

items.zh: 我昨天看了一个电影，今天又看了一个。
items.py: Wǒ zuótiān kànle yī ge diànyǐng, jīntiān yòu kànle yī ge.
items.en: I watched a film yesterday and watched another one today.

items.zh: 你只吃了一点儿饭，再吃一点儿吧。
items.py: Nǐ zhǐ chīle yīdiǎnr fàn, zài chī yīdiǎnr ba.
items.en: You've only eaten a little. Have some more.

items.zh: 家里只有一个面包了，我们再买一些吧。
items.py: Jiā li zhǐ yǒu yī ge miànbāo le, wǒmen zài mǎi yīxiē ba.
items.en: There's only one loaf of bread left at home. Let's buy some more.

items.zh: 那个饭馆我昨天去了一次，明天还想再去一次。
items.py: Nàge fànguǎn wǒ zuótiān qùle yī cì, míngtiān hái xiǎng zài qù yī cì.
items.en: I went to that restaurant once yesterday, and I want to go again tomorrow.

items.zh: 昨天去看了看，今天又去看了看，明天还要再去看看。
items.py: Zuótiān qù kànle kàn, jīntiān yòu qù kànle kàn, míngtiān hái yào zài qù kànkan.
items.en: I went to look yesterday, went again today, and will go look again tomorrow.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (Question word + 就 + question word)

items.zh: 什么东西便宜我就买什么。
items.py: Shénme dōngxi piányi wǒ jiù mǎi shénme.
items.en: I'll buy whatever is cheap.

items.zh: 你哪天有时间就哪天来我家吧。
items.py: Nǐ nǎ tiān yǒu shíjiān jiù nǎ tiān lái wǒ jiā ba.
items.en: Come to my place whichever day you have time.

items.py: Shéi xǐhuan tā tā jiù xǐhuan shéi.
items.en: He likes whoever likes him.

items.py: Nǐ zuò nǎr wǒ jiù zuò nǎr.
items.en: I'll sit wherever you sit.
